title: specs/state.json Schema
description: JSON Schema for the top-level task-management state store, specs/state.json. This is the single machine-readable definition of the state.json shape and the closed task-status enum -- scripts/lib/status-vocabulary.sh exports the same enum as a sourced shell array and MUST be kept byte-equal to this schema's status enum (see scripts/tests/test-status-vocabulary.sh's drift assertion). Scope note: this schema targets the ACTIVE state store (specs/state.json) only. specs/archive/state.json has a materially different, looser shape (archived_projects/abandoned_projects/completed_projects arrays with many one-off historical fields such as researching_2, plan_metadata, previous_status) and is deliberately NOT validated against this schema -- see context/reference/state-management-schema.md's single-source note for why the two stores are not schema-unified in this pass. Modeled structurally on schemas/events-schema.json (draft-07, required/properties/additionalProperties: false).

next_project_number.description: Next task number to assign. Vault archival (see state-management-schema.md's Vault Fields) resets this when it exceeds 1000.

default_task_type.description: Optional override of the /task keyword-routing table for all new tasks in this project (null by default; meta keywords and extension keyword_overrides still take precedence -- see the root CLAUDE.md's Task-Type-Based Routing section). Documented-optional: absent in the current live snapshot, but a real, consumed field (commands/task.md).

active_projects.description: In-flight task entries. Terminal-status entries (completed/abandoned/expanded) are archived out of this array by /todo, not deleted in place.

active_topics.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live. Distinct topic strings currently in use across active_projects entries' topic field.

completed_projects.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live (currently empty, []). Reserved for a possible future completed-but-not-yet-archived staging array; completion today moves an entry through active_projects' own status field, not into this array.

repository_health.description: Documented-optional. Aggregate repository health metrics refreshed periodically.

last_assessed.description: ISO8601 timestamp of last metrics update.

status.description: Derived from build_errors: null -> "unknown" (no applicable structural probe found -- not measured); 0 -> "healthy"; >0 -> "critical". "manageable" and "concerning" are reserved for a future graded metric and are not currently emitted by any producer.

todo_count.description: Documented-optional sub-field, confirmed live. Count of TODO: tags found by the last /fix-it-style scan.

fixme_count.description: Documented-optional sub-field, confirmed live. Count of FIXME:/FIX: tags found by the last scan.

build_errors.description: Documented-optional sub-field, confirmed live. Count of build/lint errors found by the last scan. null means no applicable structural probe found -- not measured (same nullable-field pattern as memory_health.last_distilled below), distinct from both 0 and any positive count.

phantom_paths.description: Count of git-index entries among the last scan's structural (*.sh/*.json) candidates that were absent from the worktree at assessment time -- e.g. a tracked file moved or deleted but not yet staged. Always an integer (0 when none), never null: unlike build_errors, this count is always measurable. Excluded from build_errors and from the candidate total build_errors is derived from.

memory_health.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live. Memory-vault health snapshot maintained by /distill.

version.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live. State-store schema/version marker string (e.g. "1.1.0").

vault_count.description: Documented-optional. Number of completed vault archival operations (0 initially -- genuinely zero everywhere today because the vault trigger, next_project_number > 1000, has never fired; not dead code).

vault_history.description: Documented-optional. History of vault operations with metadata; empty until the first vault operation fires.

deployment_versions.description: Documented-optional. Semantic-version deployment record, written by skill-tag (the /tag command) when a version tag is created and pushed; see skills/skill-tag/SKILL.md, which both creates this object when absent and updates it on every subsequent tag. Modelled here because the agent system itself writes it: before this entry, the schema's additionalProperties:false rejected a field one of its own skills produces, so any repo that had ever run /tag failed validate-state.sh's unknown-top-level-field check through no fault of its own.

last_deployed.description: The most recently deployed semantic version tag, e.g. "v0.1.0".

last_deployed_at.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent deployment.

deployment_history.description: Most-recent-first list of past deployments. skill-tag retains at most ten entries (it prepends the new one and slices [0:9]).

deployed_at.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of that deployment.

commit_sha.description: Full SHA of the commit the tag pointed at.

active_goal.description: Documented-optional. A free-prose statement of the repository's current overall aim, used for human orientation. No script in the agent system writes or reads it; it is authored by a repo owner or by a task that owns the repository's framing. Modelled rather than retired so that a repo carrying a real goal string does not fail validation for holding it; a repo is equally free to omit it.

taskStatus.description: The single closed task-status enum. Canonical source pair: this schema (machine-readable) and scripts/lib/status-vocabulary.sh (sourced shell anchor) -- context/standards/status-markers.md and context/reference/state-management-schema.md are human-readable glosses over this pair, never independent sources. `revising`/`revised` were deliberately deleted as dead vocabulary: unreachable through update-task-status.sh's map_status() (no `revise` case), never mentioned in state-management-schema.md, and explicitly bypassed by skill-reviser/SKILL.md's documented 'skip preflight status update' decision.

type.description: Artifact type: research, plan, summary, implementation, or an extension-defined type.

reflectionObject.description: Overwrite (not append) semantics -- see state-management-schema.md's Reflection Field section.

task_type.description: Routing key: bare value (general, meta, markdown, or an extension-provided type) or compound extension:subtype (e.g. present:grant).

title.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live on all current entries. Human-readable task title.

topic.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live on all current entries. Free-text topic label, aggregated into the top-level active_topics array.

description.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live on all current entries. Full task description.

session_id.description: Documented-optional, confirmed live. Session ID of the most recent status-changing command invocation.

effort.description: Documented-optional. Estimated effort. Zero occurrences in the current active snapshot (lifecycle-timing artifact -- 276 occurrences in specs/archive/state.json, so this is naturally sparse pre-completion, not dead.

priority.description: Documented-optional. Relative urgency, independent of dependency order: a wave-1 task may be low and a wave-3 task high. Written by /review's severity mapping and by task-creation paths that carry an explicit urgency signal; absent means unranked, NOT low. Admitted to the schema after five live entries (53, 66, 74, 75, 76) failed validate-state.sh --deep against additionalProperties: false -- the field carried real signal, so it was admitted rather than stripped.

dependencies.description: Task numbers that must complete before this task can start. No self-reference, no cycles.

file_scope.description: Documented-optional. Anticipated repo-relative paths/prefixes this task expects to touch (prospective, not filesystem-validated).

research_questions.description: Documented-optional. Planner-issued focused question list, present only after a needs_research verdict; overwrite-on-write (not additive, unlike file_scope) -- see context/reference/state-management-schema.md's Research Questions Field section.

next_artifact_number.description: Documented-optional. Next artifact sequence number (default: 1). Zero occurrences in the current active snapshot (lifecycle-timing artifact -- 308 occurrences in specs/archive/state.json).

completion_summary.description: Required when status is completed; a 1-3 sentence summary of accomplishment. Schema-optional here since only completed entries carry it.

roadmap_items.description: Documented-optional. Explicit ROADMAP.md item texts (non-meta tasks only).

memory_candidates.description: Documented-optional. Structured memory candidates emitted by agents; append-only during the task lifecycle, consumed and removed during archival.
